scope: evaluation-only renderer copy; official training source, rasterizer, and trained checkpoint remain unmodified

plane_sources.accumulated_alpha: native GOF rendered-image channel 7, sum of official front-to-back alpha-compositing weights
plane_sources.weighted_camera_z_sum: evaluation-only sum of the same official compositing weight times ray-intersection t
plane_sources.weighted_camera_z_second_moment: evaluation-only sum of the same official compositing weight times ray-intersection t squared
plane_sources.weighted_inverse_camera_z_sum: evaluation-only sum of the same official compositing weight divided by positive ray-intersection t

raw_output.camera_z_definition: GOF constructs the camera ray as (x/fx, y/fy, 1); therefore the frozen rasterizer intersection parameter t equals camera-z
raw_output.alpha_compositing: official alpha cutoff 1/255 and early termination threshold 1e-4 are unchanged
raw_output.primary_common_track: A/M1 under the official GOF compositing weights; not the native median/max-depth channel and not a level-set surface
raw_output.native_depth_channel_policy: rendered-image channel 6 is GOF median/max depth and is diagnostic only; it must never substitute for M1/A
raw_output.derived_packet_policy: derive normalized fields on CPU from the four raw float32 accumulators

target_gpu_evidence.gpu: NVIDIA RTX PRO 6000 Blackwell Server Edition

remaining_gate: target-GPU official/evaluation builds, synthetic raw-moment conformance, real-input loader, one-iteration technical smoke, 66-camera packet export, and common-evaluator qualification
